about.title: ParseKit
about.heroLead: Convert PDFs, Office files, spreadsheets, and images into clean Markdown for AI — entirely on your Mac.
about.heroBody: ParseKit transforms PDFs, Office documents, spreadsheets and images into structured Markdown that AI assistants can understand efficiently.
about.heroValue: Instead of repeatedly making language models parse complex document formats, ParseKit converts them once into lightweight, structured Markdown while preserving document structure as closely as possible.
about.localLine: Runs locally. Your files never leave your Mac.
about.privacyLine: Your files never leave your Mac.
